brief:
Israeli settlers beat press photographer Jaafar Ashtiyeh with rifle butts while covering olive farmer violence in the West Bank, The Guardian reported. The assault occurred in the presence of Israeli soldiers, who did not intervene. Ashtiyeh was hospitalised as a result of the beating.

Settler violence against Palestinians has intensified in recent months, with the photographer documenting such incidents when he was attacked.
dek: Jaafar Ashtiyeh was covering violence against olive farmers when settlers set upon him with the butts of their rifles Armed Israeli settlers beat a photographer in the presence of Israeli soldiers, hospitalising him, as he covered worsening settler violence…
title: Israeli settlers hospitalize photographer covering West Bank violence
